changeinfo.changes: Bug Fixes: - Fixed an issue where connections to a host would fail after clients disconnect and rejoin - Improved error messages when a game session is full - Clients will no longer become unresponsive while the host is editing a deck - Long (15-16 character) Online IDs with large characters in the variable-width font are no longer abbreviated in the lobby and game screens - Victories are no longer awarded when a user disconnects from the network in Random 1v1 mode - Connection error messages now more thoroughly distinguish when on host vs. client and disconnect vs. sign out.
Bug Fixes: - Resolved an issue preventing a save slot from hosting or joining co-op games once a large portion of game content was unlocked.
